title: stop.test.ts clause 12 passes on a developer host, not only in CI
body:
Source: lane reports 2026-11-15 (t-4kqzdw0, t-bxw0ben, t-8tvfrbs) and status.md 15:01 (t-t9yry9p)
Why: `clause 12: the --red mode...` in test/hook/stop.test.ts fails locally on clean main (node --test: 71 pass, 1 fail) while CI passes; every lane's npm run fast ends `fast FAIL (test)` and `bin/krn hook stop --check` exits 1 on it, so lanes ship past a red local verdict and learn to ignore it.
Outcome: the test passes locally and in CI, or its host dependency is named and the test isolates it; Stop --check and npm run fast are green on clean main on this host.
Proof: `node --test test/hook/stop.test.ts` exit 0 on this host on the merged head, with a regression assertion for the isolated dependency.
Lead trap: none (lanes are told to ignore it until this merges).
